title: For my new living toom
text: For my new living toom. I should have read the description more closely.  I was expecting the eucalyptus to be dried/real.  They are artificial and look it.  I would absolutely love it if the eucalyptus was real.  The cotton part is dried/real and looks good.  They are sturdy.  We had to cut the stems a bit for our use.  My husband had to cut them using wire cutters.  I am using them and they don’t look bad.

product_metadata.title: CEWOR 6pcs Cotton Stems 23.5" Cotton Flowers 4 Cotton Heads with Eucalyptus Leaves Per Stem Cotton Floral Stems for Fall Home Farmhouse Floral Decoration
features: [Package Contains]: 6pcs cotton stems, each with 4 cotton heads and eucalyptus leaves.
[Size]: Each cotton stem is 23.5 inches long and the cotton flower head is about 2 inches in diameter. Material: natural cotton and high-quality rayon.
[High Quality]: 100% handmade, the cotton stem can be adjusted at will, you bend into the shape you like.

[Multi Usage]: Cotton stems are great for home decoration in farmhouse style or country style, and are also suitable for weddings, offices, and the DIY of the cotton wreath or other handicrafts. Combined with other falls stems, you can feel the breath of autumn. Can also be used as a decoration for Thanksgiving, Halloween, Christmas.
[Notes]: The product is bent on easy transportation. You can adjust it according to your requirements after receiving them.
